title: AI's Secret Takeover of Music
full_monologue: **AI is rewriting the rules of the music industry.** From writing hits to mastering tracks, algorithms are now behind some of your favorite songs. Artists are using AI to create beats in seconds, and streaming platforms are using it to predict what will go viral. But is this a revolution or a threat? We’re seeing AI not just assist, but take the lead. The question is: how long until we can’t tell the difference between human and machine-made music? Comment below with your thoughts.
